# assets/vendor

Source packs the art pipeline reads. Everything here is CC0 1.0 (public domain) or
SIL OFL, so the placeholder art can ship and be replaced without licensing work.

These are placeholders. When the group delivers hand-drawn sprites, replace the files
under `assets/game/` (see `assets/README.md` for the file map) and leave this folder
alone.

| Folder | Pack | License | Source | Feeds |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `kenney/urban_tilemap` | RPG Urban Pack, 16x16 | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-urban-pack | Street and town tiles |
